description: This file extends the Duration prototype in the Moment.js date library with additional methods, including getters, conversions, and locale support, along with some deprecated functions.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the Duration object is valid.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of the duration.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a duration or number of milliseconds to the current duration.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts a duration or number of milliseconds from the current duration.

methods.name: as
methods.description: Returns the duration expressed in the specified units.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Returns the primitive value of the duration.

methods.name: _bubble
methods.description: Internal method for recalculating the duration's state.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Gets a specific value from the duration.

methods.name: humanize
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representing the duration.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Returns ISO string representation of the duration.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation, delegated to toISOString.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Returns JSON representation, delegated to toISOString.

methods.name: locale
methods.description: Gets or sets the locale for the duration.
